title: Rebalance shards from 10-shard CI durations
body:
Outcome: the 10-shard plan stops overloading one shard, so the slowest Test step moves toward the shard mean.
Evidence: main runs since 2194438 (42429805266, 42430428146, 42430864780, 42431526060): shard 3 ran 14/18/18/18 s while shards 1 and 5 ran 10-13 s; node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since 2194438 flags 23 files whose median CI duration exceeds their weight by more than 30% (worst test/worker/hardening-baseline.test.ts 13.2 s vs weight 6.8); both models correlate weakly (summed r=0.35, heaviest-lane r=-0.17).
Acceptance: node scripts/shard-weights-refresh.mjs --runs 5 --write over 10-shard main runs only; then 5 main runs since that commit print a slowest Test step p50 below 18 s and fewer drifted files (node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <refresh sha>).

Note: Pearson r cannot judge a balanced plan (predicted walls 43.4-43.5 summed and 10.9-11.7 lane s barely vary, so r was 0.35 and -0.20 over 5 runs); judge per-shard medians across runs (shard 3 at 18 s in 3 of 5) and the slowest-step p50, or replace the r verdict in scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs with a shard-rank consistency check.

Refresh e9ebc8f (window start): weights from 10-shard main runs 42437333036 42437063331 42436168431 42436014411 42435706998; test/worker/state-trust.test.ts (12.2 s) and test/worker/recovery.test.ts (11.7 s) split under the 11 s file bound with apportioned weights. Baseline over those runs at 1dd36d6 (node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --runs 5): slowest Test step p50 17 s, 17 drifted files, shard p50 11-16 s (shard 3 highest). On their per-file medians the old plan summed 23.5-55.5 s per shard (lane wall 9.6-14.6 s), the refreshed plan 42.4-42.5 s (lane wall 10.7-11.8 s). Close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f prints runs: 5 of 5 with a slowest Test step p50 below 18 s and fewer than 17 drifted files.

Window run 1: main 42438874107 (051c00a) Test steps 8-19 s, slowest 19 s (shard 7); PR run 42438789064 also peaked at 19 s (shard 6). In both runs evals/workspace.test.ts ran 10.6-12.6 s against weight 5.1 beside evals/workspace-mask.test.ts in shard 6, and main shard 7 carried worker/hardening-redaction.test.ts at 11.7 s against 4.3. If the window's drift section keeps flagging same-family files, test family anti-affinity in planTestShards or refresh once more before closing; per-shard p50 comes with t-5fs38a3.

Window verdict, 5 of 5 since e9ebc8f (main 42438874107 42439302711 42440860512 42441356963 42442106709): FAIL. Slowest Test step p50 19 s (target below 18 s, baseline 17 s), 32 drifted files (baseline 17); shard p50: 1/10=14 2/10=14 3/10=14 4/10=19 5/10=9 6/10=16 7/10=16 8/10=12 9/10=13 10/10=18 s; highest 4/10 +4.5 s over the mean 14.5 s. The shard rank follows each shard's longest file, not its summed weight: 4/10 holds test/worker/acceptance-checks-reruns.test.ts at a 15.5 s CI median (weight 10.1) and 10/10 holds test/worker/acceptance-checks-observers.test.ts at 14.2 s (weight 8.8); the 11 s file bound passed on weights that lag CI by up to 53%, so the report now prints a 'files over the 11 s bound' line from CI medians and gates the slowest p50 at 18 s. Next, after t-dddwdtg lands: split every file that line lists, refresh from 10-shard main runs that include the splits, and open a new window; close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <refresh sha> prints runs: 5 of 5, 'target < 18 s: PASS', 'files over the 11 s bound: none' and fewer than 17 drifted files.

Refresh e79cb01 (window start): weights from 10-shard main runs 42445125280 42444826902 42443183605 42443064364 42442826299; the three files on the e9ebc8f report's 'files over the 11 s bound' line split by theme with apportioned weights: acceptance-checks-observers 7.9 + acceptance-checks-containment 6.5 (parent 14.4 s), acceptance-checks-reruns 6.4 + acceptance-checks-validation 6.3 (parent 12.7 s), hardening-redaction 7.2 + hardening-allow 4.6 (parent 11.8 s). Baseline: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f at d2a2baf printed slowest Test step p50 18 s (FAIL), shard 4/10 highest at 18 s, 26 drifted files. On those CI medians the main plan's lane walls span 7.8-17.6 s, the refreshed plan's 11.1-12.0 s. Close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e79cb01 prints runs: 5 of 5, 'target < 18 s: PASS', 'files over the 11 s bound: none' and fewer than 17 drifted files.
